developer.bio:
Enterprise Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Solution Architect with 7+ years of service delivery, operations leadership, and dual-track transformation experience.

Proven track record leading large-scale digital modernization programs — architecting a transformation that catalogued 361 legacy Lotus Domino forms and deployed 16 production Power Apps across 28+ departments. The architecture follows a Dataverse-first strategy with SharePoint Online serving strictly as an interim staging layer during Phase 1 to eliminate $960K/yr in premium licensing costs.

Expertise spans Dataverse data architecture with Business Units, Security Roles, Field Security Profiles, and polymorphic lookups; enterprise ALM with GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines using Power Platform Build Tools; C# Dataverse Plugins on Pre/Post-Operation pipeline stages; PCF Controls (TypeScript/React); and AI-assisted development with domain-specific Copilot assistants governed by DLP policies and content filtering. Power Platform governance aligned to WCAG 2.2 AA, OWASP Top 10, and GxP compliance standards, with 98%+ SLA compliance.
